about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover P400 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover P400 uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine. It was introduced with the L460 generation from 2022 and remains in production. The AJ300P is part of JLR's Ingenium engine family and represents a more modern design than the older TDV6/SDV6 diesel units that preceded it in the Range Rover line-up. The P400 badge denotes the power output tier within the petrol range.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P engines for every Range Rover P400 on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover P400 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the Range Rover P400 uses a specific engine code (AJ300P) within the broader Ingenium family, fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts compatibility with other variants risks a problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ300P) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
